verdict.rationale: ROS 2's official documentation includes a tutorial titled "Launch a Simulation with Gazebo and ROS 2", and a long-time user says ROS gives you simulation largely for free if you follow its conventions. However, the physics and sensor simulation comes from the separate Gazebo simulator through integration, not from ROS 2 itself. Missing for 10: evidence of realistic physics engines and sensor models (e.g. lidar or camera noise), detail on how simulated robots and environments are defined, and hands-on corroboration of sim-to-hardware fidelity.
